question: can flashnext run concurrently with ds4-flash or glm53-flash?

tests.cause: flashnext stages 31.4 of 32 GB on the R9700; DS4-flash then needs 3.6 GB more on the card and fails (cudaMalloc OOM). Both engines demand the same 32 GB VRAM for their hot expert/attention sets.

GLM EXL3 needs ~100 GB of Strix GTT; with flashnext resident, Strata's torch arena had already reserved the pool (torch OOM at 118 GiB capacity). Shrinking one side (GLM ctx < 32K, or capping Strata with --resident-budget-gib) might make it fit but is untested.

implication: The only proven dual-resident pairing remains qwen38-27b (R9700) + glm53-flash EXL3 (Strix GTT) at 2-9% mutual cost. flashnext reserves nearly all of the card and cannot share it.
